overview.description: The KraneShares Asia AI Technology ETF (KAIT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in companies involved in the Asia AI technology value chain. The fund seeks growth of capital. KAIT was launched on Aug 19, 2026 and is issued by KraneShares.

holdings.infoBox: KAIT is an equity ETF with a total of 53 individual holdings. The top holdings are Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company stock at 7.33%, SK hynix at 4.87%, Advantest at 4.82%, Samsung Electronics at 4.73%, and Asia Vital Components at 3.96%.
